dedupe_keys.name: a hybrid model for fast and probabilistic urban pluvial flood prediction dataset

description: Xiaohan Li publishes the inputs and evaluation data for a hybrid urban pluvial flood model in Gent and Antwerp, Belgium. Each city folder supplies one-dimensional sewer-network geodata, catchment boundary conditions and spatial rainfall configurations. Calibration files contain rainfall and flood records; evaluation files add rainfall events, predicted flood probabilities and observations for comparison. The March 2020 deposit provides Data.zip free under CC BY 4.0. The metadata do not establish the observation dates, sampling intervals, sewer inventory size or internal file formats, so these remain unknown. A modeller could reconstruct network topology or compare probabilistic flood simulations against the supplied events. Predictions and observations must be distinguished when assessing performance. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. The archive was not downloaded, and compatibility with a particular hydraulic solver was not tested.
